summary: November 2, 2026 briefing compared with the October 30 edition. Delta Reign's November 6 release remains confirmed; three additional Target product mappings are now verified, alongside its display. All four checked Target Delta Reign pages show out of stock, without a verified opening hour or numeric cap. Walmart's hubs still show closed drawings and an undated Wednesday queue banner. Sam's no-returns rule for trading cards is newly covered, not a proven new policy. No substantive newly introduced purchase-limit or checkout-rule change was established for October 26–November 2. Pokémon Center product pages and Sam's product access remain limited; local inventory and signed-in eligibility were not tested.

retailers.coverage: Read four Delta Reign product pages, two Battle Deck pages and preorder help. Three Delta Reign mappings are additions to October 30 coverage, not documented new listings or rule changes. No numeric item cap or confirmed opening hour found; local stock, signed-in checkout and broad catalog completeness are unverified. Third-party bundles are separate offers.

confirmed.title: Preorder cart/payment baseline
confirmed.details: FAQ advises separate preorder orders but also allows matching release dates together; differing dates and preorder/in-stock mixes must be separate. Credit/debit only, no gift cards/Apple Pay/PayPal for preorders. Address cannot change; invalid payment can cancel without reinstatement.
confirmed.planningImpact: Use separate preorder orders conservatively while checking live guidance. Ensure accurate address and valid payment. This is continued baseline coverage, not a newly announced restriction.
checks: Read payment-processing notices and product-specific cart rules.

confirmed.title: Queue does not establish a launch or stock
confirmed.details: Keep one queue window open without refreshing; use the US site and product-page limits. The queue does not necessarily indicate a launch or guarantee availability. 30th Celebration guidance recommends accurate trusted addresses and account login.
confirmed.planningImpact: Wait for an official product offer and numeric allowance; do not infer a drop from a queue or attempt workarounds.
checks: Verify product cap; keep preorder and in-stock carts separate.
